summary: Specifies a form of response to a one-time password challenge that states how the response is encoded. It also defines a response that lets a generator ask the server to re-initialize a sequence and change parameters like the secret pass phrase.

eli5.summary: One-time passwords are used once and thrown away. This adds a way to say how a password is written, and to start a fresh batch when you run low.

questions: how to reinitialize a one-time password sequence
